items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Trumpets were Jimmy Maxwell, Joe Newman, Joe Wilder and Johnny Frosk.

ctx.x: It was Zoot Sims, Tommy Newsom, I think Gene Allen was playing baritone, Phil Woods and Jerry Dodgion was playing second alto. Trombone were Jimmy Knepper, Willie Dennis and myself. Trumpets were Jimmy Maxwell, Joe Newman, Joe Wilder and Johnny Frosk. And the rhythm section was Mel Lewis, bass was Bill Crow and the piano was John Bunch. And the other piano player, who unfortunately didn’t get to play very much, Teddy Wilson. Can you believe that? He didn’t get to play. Benny wouldn’t let him play you know. After…
Oh yeah, Joya Sherrill. Well does he live up to his reputation? Did he live up to his reputation on that trip?

items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And both Phil Woods and the trombone player, he used to be married to a French horn player, black girl who was a French horn player.

ctx.x: on the Russians. I told them, boy, you know, anyone who drinks 32 toasts in a row has seen a drunk before. I said, don't worry about it.

So we go back to the hotel on this bus and one of the interpreters, this girl is sitting with me. And both Phil Woods and the trombone player, he used to be married to a French horn player, black girl who was a French horn player.
